mapper.select: SELECT r.rental_id AS rentalId, r.equipment_id AS equipmentId, e.equipment_name AS equipmentName, u.user_name AS userName, r.rental_date AS rentalDate, r.return_date AS returnDate FROM RENTAL r JOIN EQUIPMENT e ON r.equipment_id = e.equipment_id JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.equipment_id = #{equipmentId}
